rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when people or things are apart rather than together.

example.english: These two tables need to be placed separately; don’t push them together.
example.traditional: 呢兩張枱要分開擺，唔好撈埋一齊。
example.jyutping: ne1 loeng5 zoeng1 toi2 jiu3 fan1 hoi1 baai2 m4 hou2 lou1 maai4 jat1 cai4

rows.note: Use this when each person or group does something on their own, emphasizing separate individual action.

example.english: We went home separately after dinner.
example.traditional: 食完飯，我哋各自返屋企。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 faan6 ngo5 dei6 gok3 zi6 faan1 uk1 kei2
